description: Street trees, one per line: [treeid, x, z, class, height m]. class indexes `classes`. Placed from San Francisco Public Works' Street Tree Inventory; height from trunk diameter (pipeline/lib/street-trees.ts). Trees whose trunks or low branches overlap rendered roads are omitted for both drawing and solid props. Ids for knockable props: tree:<treeid>.
attribution: San Francisco Street Tree Inventory: San Francisco Public Works via DataSF (tkzw-k3nq), ODC PDDL 1.0.
